zh: 我升职了！
en: I've been promoted!
alt: I got promoted!
point: 升职 → have been promoted，不是 I promoted

zh: 我们办公室在装修。
en: Our office is being renovated.
alt: They're doing up our office.
point: 正在被装修 → is being renovated，进行时被动

zh: 你的账号锁了。
en: Your account's been locked.
alt: Your account has been locked.
point: 中文没有「被」，英文要用被动 has been locked

zh: 这个网站是用Python写的。
en: This website's written in Python.
alt: The site was built in Python.
point: 是…写的 → is written in，主语是网站

zh: 这道菜是用本地羊肉做的。
en: This dish is made with local lamb.
alt: This dish uses local lamb.
point: 用…做的 → is made with，不是 makes with

zh: 这张桌子有人订了。
en: This table's been booked.
alt: This table's reserved.
point: 有人订了 → has been booked，不必说 someone

zh: 我们队被淘汰了。
en: We've been knocked out.
alt: Our team got knocked out.
point: 被淘汰 → got knocked out / have been knocked out

zh: 他被罚下场了。
en: He got sent off.
alt: He was sent off.
point: 被罚下场 → got sent off，口语常用 get 被动

zh: 这件T恤是中国产的。
en: This T-shirt was made in China.
alt: This T-shirt is made in China.
point: …产的 → was made in，主语是衣服

zh: 那款已经卖完了。
en: That one's sold out.
alt: That one's already sold out.
We've sold out of that one.
point: 卖完了 → is sold out，不是 that one sell out

zh: 我们的航班延误了。
en: Our flight's been delayed.
alt: Our flight has been delayed.
point: 延误了 → has been delayed，不是 our flight delayed

zh: 我的行李丢了。
en: My bag got lost.
alt: My luggage has gone missing.
The airline's lost my bag.
point: 行李丢了 → got lost，不是 my bag lost

zh: 我被蜜蜂蜇了。
en: I got stung by a bee.
alt: I was stung by a bee.
point: 被…蜇 → got stung by，sting 的过去分词是 stung

zh: 他住院了。
en: He's been taken to hospital.
alt: He's been admitted to hospital.
He's in hospital.
point: 住院 → has been taken to hospital，英式不加 the

zh: 我家昨晚进贼了。
en: Our house got broken into last night.
alt: Our place was burgled last night.
point: 进贼 → got broken into / was burgled

zh: 碗洗好了。
en: The dishes have been done.
alt: The dishes are done.
point: 洗好了 → have been done，不是 the dishes washed

zh: 她请我去参加她的婚礼。
en: I've been invited to her wedding.
alt: She's invited me to her wedding.
point: 换成「我」做主语 → I've been invited to

zh: 她是在基督城出生的。
en: She was born in Christchurch.
alt: She's from Christchurch originally.
point: 出生 → was born，不能说 she born

zh: 今天发工资了。
en: I got paid today.
alt: We got paid today.
Payday was today.
point: 发工资 → got paid，主语是拿钱的人

zh: 我的卡被取款机吞了。
en: My card got swallowed by the ATM.
alt: The ATM ate my card.
point: 被…吞 → got swallowed by，或主动说 the ATM ate it

zh: 我们新来的经理是从惠灵顿那边调过来的。
en: Our new manager has been brought in from the Wellington office.
alt: Our new manager's been transferred from the Wellington office.
point: 调过来 → has been brought in / transferred

zh: 这份合同得经理签了字才能生效。
en: This contract needs to be signed by a manager before it's valid.
alt: A manager has to sign this contract before it comes into effect.
point: 得签字 → needs to be signed by，情态 + 被动

zh: 所有数据每天晚上都会自动备份。
en: All the data is backed up automatically every night.
alt: Everything gets backed up automatically every night.
point: 自动备份 → is backed up，主语是数据

zh: 那个bug上周就修好了，你更新一下就行。
en: That bug was fixed last week, so just update and you'll be fine.
alt: That bug got fixed last week, so you just need to update.
point: 修好了 → was fixed，主语是 bug，不是 bug fixed

zh: 您点的菜还在做，再等几分钟就好。
en: Your meals are still being prepared. They'll be out in a few minutes.
alt: Your food's still being cooked, it'll be out in a few minutes.
point: 还在做 → are still being prepared，进行时被动

zh: 这家店被评为奥克兰最好的早午餐店。
en: This place was voted the best brunch spot in Auckland.
alt: This café was named the best brunch place in Auckland.
point: 被评为 → was voted / was named，后面直接接名词

zh: 他入选国家队了，下个月去打第一场比赛。
en: He's been picked for the national team, and he plays his first game next month.
alt: He's been selected for the national side and has his first match next month.
point: 入选 → has been picked for / selected for

zh: 比赛电视上直播，你在家就能看。
en: The game's being shown live on TV, so you can watch it at home.
alt: The match is being broadcast live, so you can watch it from home.
point: 直播 → is being shown live，节目是被播的

zh: 这家店下个月要被一家大连锁店收购了。
en: This shop's being taken over by a big chain next month.
alt: A big chain is taking over this shop next month.
point: 被收购 → is being taken over by，表示已定的将来

zh: 沙发周四送货，送之前会有人打电话给你。
en: The couch will be delivered on Thursday, and you'll get a call beforehand.
alt: Your sofa's being delivered on Thursday, and someone will ring you first.
point: 送货 → will be delivered，主语是沙发

zh: 他们通知我们航班取消了，只能明天再走。
en: We were told the flight had been cancelled, so we're stuck here until tomorrow.
alt: They told us the flight was cancelled, so we can't leave till tomorrow.
point: 被通知 → were told；已取消 → had been cancelled

zh: 我在机场被抽中检查行李了。
en: My bag got pulled aside for a random check at the airport.
alt: I got picked for a random bag search at the airport.
point: 被抽查 → got pulled aside / got picked for

zh: 我下周去拔智齿。
en: I'm getting my wisdom teeth taken out next week.
alt: I'm having my wisdom teeth out next week.
point: 让别人给自己做 → get/have + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 他查出了糖尿病，现在吃东西得注意了。
en: He's been diagnosed with diabetes, so he has to watch what he eats now.
alt: He was diagnosed with diabetes, so he's got to be careful with his diet now.
point: 查出… → has been diagnosed with，人是被诊断的

zh: 房顶漏水了，入冬之前得修一下。
en: The roof's leaking and needs fixing before winter.
alt: The roof's leaking and needs to be fixed before winter.
point: 得修 → needs fixing / needs to be fixed

zh: 这房子是上世纪三十年代盖的，从来没做过保温。
en: This house was built back in the 1930s and has never been insulated.
alt: The house dates from the 1930s and was never insulated.
point: 盖于 → was built；从没做保温 → has never been insulated

zh: 我被拉进了一个群聊，消息多得根本看不过来。
en: I got added to a group chat and I can't keep up with all the messages.
alt: Someone added me to a group chat and there are way too many messages to keep up with.
point: 被拉进群 → got added to，不是 was pulled into

zh: 他们的婚礼在霍克斯湾的一个酒庄办的。
en: Their wedding was held at a vineyard in Hawke's Bay.
alt: They had their wedding at a winery in Hawke's Bay.
point: 婚礼办在 → was held at，活动是被举办的

zh: 我的卡信息在网上被盗了，卡已经停掉了。
en: My card details were stolen online, and the card's been cancelled.
alt: Someone stole my card details online, so the card's been stopped.
point: 被盗 → were stolen；停掉了 → has been cancelled

zh: 我的电费每个月自动扣款。
en: My power bill is paid by direct debit every month.
alt: My power bill comes out automatically every month.
point: 自动扣款 → is paid by direct debit；电费 → power bill

zh: 这个项目先搁置了，因为财务那边预算到现在还没批下来。
en: The project's been put on hold because the budget still hasn't been approved by finance.
alt: We've had to put the project on hold, since the budget hasn't been signed off yet.
point: 搁置 → has been put on hold；还没批 → hasn't been approved

zh: 上面要求我们周五之前把工时表都交上去，不然工资会晚发。
en: We've been asked to get our timesheets in by Friday, otherwise our pay will be delayed.
alt: We've been told to submit our timesheets by Friday or our pay will be held up.
point: 上面要求 → we've been asked to；晚发 → will be delayed

zh: 昨晚的宕机是一个配置错误造成的，现在已经解决了，我们正在写事故报告。
en: Last night's outage was caused by a config error. It's been sorted now, and we're writing up an incident report.
alt: A configuration error caused last night's outage. It's been fixed, and we're putting together an incident report.
point: …造成的 → was caused by；已解决 → has been sorted

zh: 你的权限还没开通，等IT批下来以后你就能进共享盘了。
en: Your access hasn't been set up yet, but once IT approves it, you'll be able to get into the shared drive.
alt: Your permissions haven't been granted yet. Once IT signs them off, you'll have access to the shared drive.
point: 还没开通 → hasn't been set up yet，主语是权限

zh: 我的牛排煎老了，退回去以后他们马上就给换了一份，一句话都没多说。
en: My steak was overcooked, so I sent it back and it was replaced straight away, no questions asked.
alt: My steak came out overdone, so I sent it back and they swapped it straight away without any fuss.
point: 煎老了 → was overcooked；给换了 → was replaced

zh: 这里的海鲜每天早上直接从码头运过来，所以特别新鲜。
en: The seafood here is brought in straight from the wharf every morning, which is why it's so fresh.
alt: They bring the seafood in fresh from the wharf every morning, so it's really fresh.
point: 运过来 → is brought in，中文主动形式英文用被动

zh: 决赛因为天气原因推迟到下周日了，已经买了票的可以退款。
en: The final's been postponed to next Sunday because of the weather, and anyone who's already bought a ticket can get a refund.
alt: The final has been pushed back to next Sunday due to the weather, and ticket holders can get their money back.
point: 推迟 → has been postponed，主语是比赛

zh: 他上赛季被禁赛三周，因为一次高位擒抱被视频裁判抓到了。
en: He was suspended for three weeks last season after a high tackle was picked up by the TMO.
alt: He got a three-week ban last season when the TMO caught him making a high tackle.
point: 被禁赛 → was suspended；被抓到 → was picked up by

zh: 我买的电视送到的时候屏幕已经碎了，客服说会给我换一台新的。
en: The TV I ordered had been damaged by the time it arrived, but customer service said it'd be replaced with a new one.
alt: My new TV turned up with a cracked screen, but customer service said they'd replace it.
point: 送到时已坏 → had been damaged；会换 → would be replaced

zh: 这款手机已经召回了，因为电池可能过热，你可以拿回店里全额退款。
en: This phone's been recalled because the battery can overheat, so you can take it back to the store for a full refund.
alt: They've recalled this phone because the battery might overheat, so you can return it for a full refund.
point: 召回 → has been recalled，主语是手机

zh: 我们去机场的路上堵了一个小时，差点没赶上飞机。
en: We got stuck in traffic for an hour on the way to the airport and nearly missed our flight.
alt: We were stuck in traffic for an hour on the way to the airport and almost missed the plane.
point: 堵车 → got stuck in traffic，不是 we were blocked

zh: 酒店说我们的房间免费升级成了海景房，而且早餐也包含在房价里。
en: The hotel told us we'd been upgraded to a sea-view room, and breakfast was included in the price.
alt: At check-in we found out we'd been given a free upgrade to a sea-view room, with breakfast included.
point: 被升级 → had been upgraded；包含 → was included

zh: 我妈上周做了膝盖手术，医生说至少还要留院观察两天。
en: My mum had knee surgery last week, and she's being kept in hospital for at least two more days for observation.
alt: Mum had a knee operation last week, and they're keeping her in for observation for at least another two days.
point: 留院观察 → is being kept in；做手术 → had surgery

zh: 今年65岁以上的人打流感疫苗免费，大部分药房都能打，不用预约。
en: Flu jabs are free for over-65s this year, and they can be done at most pharmacies without an appointment.
alt: Over-65s can get a free flu jab this year at most pharmacies, no appointment needed.
point: 能打 → can be done，中文主动英文被动

zh: 房东要卖房子，租约提前终止了，只给了我们一个月时间搬走。
en: Our tenancy's been ended early because the landlord's selling, and we've only been given a month to move out.
alt: The landlord's selling the house, so our lease has been cut short and we've got just a month to find somewhere else.
point: 被终止 → has been ended；只给了一个月 → we've been given

zh: 楼上的水管爆了，我们家天花板泡坏了，估计得整个换掉。
en: A pipe burst in the flat upstairs and our ceiling got badly damaged, so it'll probably have to be replaced.
alt: A pipe burst upstairs and wrecked our ceiling, so the whole thing will probably need replacing.
point: 泡坏了 → got damaged；得换 → will have to be replaced

zh: 在派对上她把我介绍给她几个同事，可我一个名字都没记住。
en: I was introduced to a few of her workmates at the party, but I can't remember any of their names.
alt: She introduced me to a few of her colleagues at the party, but I've forgotten all their names.
point: 被介绍给 → was introduced to，换「我」做主语

zh: 周六的烧烤要是下雨可能就取消了，我周五晚上再跟大家确认。
en: Saturday's barbecue might be called off if it rains, so I'll confirm with everyone on Friday night.
alt: The barbecue on Saturday could get cancelled if it rains, so I'll let everyone know on Friday night.
point: 可能取消 → might be called off，情态动词 + 被动

zh: 我上个月的工资多扣了税，财务说下次发工资的时候会退给我。
en: Too much tax was taken out of my pay last month, but payroll says it'll be refunded in my next pay.
alt: I was overtaxed last month, but payroll says I'll get it back in my next pay.
point: 多扣了 → was taken out of；会退 → will be refunded

zh: 那套房子挂出来不到一周就被人买走了，比要价高了五万。
en: That house was snapped up within a week of being listed, for fifty grand over the asking price.
alt: That house sold within a week of going on the market, for fifty thousand over the asking price.
point: 被抢购 → was snapped up；挂牌 → being listed

zh: 我们组一半人被裁了。
en: Half our team got made redundant.
alt: Half our team was laid off.
point: 被裁员 → be made redundant / get laid off，不是 cut

zh: 我的邮箱被黑了。
en: My email's been hacked.
alt: My email account got hacked.
point: 被黑 → has been hacked，不是 my email hacked

zh: 我们的菜上错了。
en: We've been given the wrong order.
alt: We got the wrong food.
point: 上错了 → we've been given，换成「我们」做被动主语

zh: 我当上队长了。
en: I've been made captain.
alt: I've been picked as captain.
point: 当上队长 → have been made captain，make 的被动

zh: 这个包裹寄错地址了。
en: This parcel was sent to the wrong address.
alt: This parcel's gone to the wrong address.
point: 寄错了 → was sent to the wrong address，主语是包裹

zh: 我们俩的座位被分开了。
en: Our seats have been split up.
alt: We've been seated apart.
point: 被分开 → have been split up，短语动词的被动

zh: 我的预约改到周五了。
en: My appointment's been moved to Friday.
alt: My appointment's been changed to Friday.
point: 改到 → has been moved to，中文无「被」英文要被动

zh: 垃圾已经收走了。
en: The rubbish has been collected.
alt: The rubbish has been picked up.
point: 收走了 → has been collected，主语是垃圾

zh: 我被放鸽子了。
en: I got stood up.
alt: I've been stood up.
point: 放鸽子 → get stood up，被动表示「被爽约」

zh: 他们给我发offer了！
en: I've been offered the job!
alt: I got offered the job!
point: 给我发offer → I've been offered，「我」做被动主语

zh: 我的申请被拒了。
en: My application got turned down.
alt: My application was rejected.
point: 被拒 → got turned down，turn down 的被动

zh: 他们叫我去第二轮面试。
en: I've been called back for a second interview.
alt: I've been asked back for a second interview.
point: 他们叫我去 → I've been called back，省掉「他们」

zh: 考试成绩出来了。
en: The exam results have been released.
alt: The exam results are out.
point: 成绩出来了 → have been released，不是 results came out 也可

zh: 我被大学录取了！
en: I've been accepted into uni!
alt: I got into uni!
point: 被录取 → have been accepted into，介词用 into

zh: 这本书已经有人借走了。
en: This book's already been borrowed.
alt: Someone's already checked this book out.
point: 有人借走了 → has been borrowed，不必说 someone

zh: 押金退回来了。
en: Our bond's been refunded.
alt: We've got our bond back.
point: 押金退了 → bond has been refunded，主语是押金

zh: 这套房已经租出去了。
en: This flat's already been rented out.
alt: This flat's already been taken.
point: 租出去了 → has been rented out，不是 has rented

zh: 房租又涨了。
en: The rent's been put up again.
alt: Our rent's gone up again.
point: 房东涨租 → has been put up，或不及物 has gone up

zh: 隔壁的猫找到了。
en: The neighbours' cat has been found.
alt: Next door's cat has turned up.
point: 猫找到了 → has been found，不是 the cat found

zh: 我的车被堵在里面了。
en: My car's been blocked in.
alt: Someone's blocked my car in.
point: 被堵在里面 → has been blocked in，别漏 in

zh: 那棵大树被砍了。
en: That big tree's been cut down.
alt: They've cut down that big tree.
point: 被砍 → has been cut down，cut 过去分词不变

zh: 我们家的网被断了。
en: Our internet's been cut off.
alt: Our broadband's been disconnected.
point: 被断网 → has been cut off，不是 internet broke

zh: 电费已经交了。
en: The power bill's been paid.
alt: I've already paid the power bill.
point: 交了 → has been paid，账单做主语

zh: 新燃气表下周装。
en: The new gas meter's being installed next week.
alt: They're installing the new gas meter next week.
point: 下周装 → is being installed，进行时被动表将来安排

zh: 洗衣机修好了。
en: The washing machine's been fixed.
alt: The washing machine's been repaired.
point: 修好了 → has been fixed，主语是洗衣机

zh: 热水器得换了。
en: The hot water cylinder needs to be replaced.
alt: The hot water cylinder needs replacing.
point: 得换 → needs to be replaced / needs replacing

zh: 门锁已经换好了。
en: The locks have been changed.
alt: The locks have been replaced.
point: 换好了 → have been changed，中文主动英文被动

zh: 我的工作签证批了！
en: My work visa's been approved!
alt: My work visa got approved!
point: 批下来 → has been approved，不是 my visa approved

zh: 表格已经寄出去了。
en: The form's been sent off.
alt: The form's been posted.
point: 寄出去 → has been sent off，短语动词被动

zh: 护照会寄到你家里。
en: Your passport will be posted to your home address.
alt: Your passport will be sent to your home.
point: 会寄到 → will be posted to，将来时被动

zh: 我的车被偷了！
en: My car's been stolen!
alt: Someone's stolen my car!
point: 被偷 → has been stolen，steal 的过去分词是 stolen

zh: 有个游泳的人在海滩被救上来了。
en: A swimmer was rescued at the beach.
alt: A swimmer got pulled out of the water at the beach.
point: 被救上来 → was rescued，不是 rescued 单独用

zh: 整条街都被封了。
en: The whole street's been cordoned off.
alt: The whole street's been closed off.
point: 封街 → has been cordoned off，警方封锁的说法

zh: 我超速被罚了。
en: I got fined for speeding.
alt: I was fined for speeding.
point: 被罚 → got fined for，不是 I fined

zh: 我的车被拖走了。
en: My car's been towed.
alt: My car's been towed away.
point: 被拖走 → has been towed，主语是车

zh: 这条路在修。
en: This road's being repaired.
alt: They're doing roadworks on this road.
point: 在修 → is being repaired，进行时被动

zh: 我昨天在海边晒伤了。
en: I got sunburnt at the beach yesterday.
alt: I got burnt at the beach yesterday.
point: 晒伤 → got sunburnt，不是 I sunburn

zh: 步道因为塌方封了。
en: The track's been closed because of a slip.
alt: The track's shut because of a slip.
point: 封了 → has been closed；新西兰把塌方叫 slip

zh: 我们被雨淋透了。
en: We got soaked.
alt: We got drenched in the rain.
point: 被淋透 → got soaked，get + 过去分词

zh: 我刚去理发店剪了头发。
en: I've just had my hair cut at the barber's.
alt: I just got my hair cut at the barber's.
point: 剪头发是别人剪 → got my hair cut，不是 I cut my hair

zh: 这部电影是根据真实故事改编的。
en: This film's based on a true story.
alt: This movie is based on real events.
point: 根据…改编 → is based on，不是 bases on

zh: 这本书拍成电影了。
en: This book's been made into a film.
alt: They've turned this book into a movie.
point: 拍成电影 → has been made into a film

zh: 婚礼定在三月了。
en: The wedding's been set for March.
alt: The wedding's been booked for March.
point: 定在 → has been set for，介词用 for

zh: 这个礼物包得真漂亮。
en: This present's beautifully wrapped.
alt: This gift has been wrapped so nicely.
point: 包得漂亮 → is beautifully wrapped，副词放分词前

zh: 蛋糕已经订好了。
en: The cake's been ordered.
alt: I've already ordered the cake.
point: 订好了 → has been ordered，主语是蛋糕

zh: 我儿子被老师表扬了。
en: My son got praised by his teacher.
alt: My son's teacher praised him.
point: 被表扬 → got praised by，by 引出动作者

zh: 我是外婆带大的。

en: She was moved to tears.

en: The new system's being rolled out next month, and we'll all be trained on it.

point: 自动更新 → got updated automatically，手机是被更新的

zh: 这家店的饺子都是每天早上现包的。
en: The dumplings here are made fresh by hand every morning.
alt: They make the dumplings fresh by hand here every morning.
point: 现包的 → are made fresh，一般现在时被动表习惯

zh: 今晚的比赛因为下雨取消了，改到周日。
en: Tonight's game has been rained off and moved to Sunday.
alt: Tonight's match has been called off because of rain and moved to Sunday.
point: 因雨取消 → has been rained off，英式说法

point: 被拦下 → were stopped；被检查 → were searched

en: My blood test results have been sent to my GP.

point: 发给了 → have been sent to，结果做主语

point: 翻新过 → was redone / got renovated，主语是厨房

point: 被硬拉去 → got dragged along to，口语 get 被动

alt: This month's mortgage payment has already come out of my account.
point: 扣款 → has been taken out of，不是 deducted my account

zh: 是我以前的同事推荐我去面试这个开发岗位的。
en: I was put forward for this developer role by an old colleague.
alt: An old colleague recommended me for this developer role.
point: 被推荐 → was put forward for，换「我」做主语

alt: The interview's set for 10am Tuesday at their office in town.
point: 安排在 → has been scheduled for，时间前用 for

en: The position's already been filled, so they never got back to me.
alt: They'd already found someone for the job, so they never replied.
point: 招到人了 → the position has been filled，职位做主语

zh: 这门课的作业必须网上交，纸质的不收。
en: Assignments for this course have to be submitted online, and paper copies aren't accepted.
alt: You've got to hand in assignments online for this course; they don't take paper copies.
point: 必须交 → have to be submitted；不收 → aren't accepted

zh: 我拿到了奖学金，学费全包了。
en: I've been awarded a scholarship, so my fees are fully covered.
alt: I got a scholarship, so all my fees are paid for.
point: 拿到奖学金 → have been awarded；学费全包 → are covered

alt: Today's class is off because the tutor's unwell.
point: 课取消了 → has been cancelled，别写成 class cancelled

zh: 这套房子带家具，连洗衣机都配了。
en: The flat comes fully furnished, and even a washing machine is provided.
alt: The flat's fully furnished and there's even a washing machine.
point: 带家具 → furnished；配了 → is provided，分词作表语

alt: We've renewed our lease for another year and the rent's staying the same.
point: 租约续了 → has been renewed，主语是 lease

en: We've been told there's a property inspection next Wednesday.
alt: The property manager's let us know there's an inspection next Wednesday.
point: 通知我们 → we've been told，被告知用 tell 的被动

en: The streetlights on our road haven't been fixed for weeks.
alt: Nobody's fixed the streetlights on our street for weeks.
point: 没人修 → haven't been fixed，否定完成时被动

zh: 社区花园是一群志愿者在打理。

alt: A group of volunteers looks after the community garden.

alt: Someone complained about next door because their dog barks all night.
point: 被投诉 → a complaint was made about，不说 was complained

point: 停水 → is being shut off；修水管 → are repaired

en: My mobile plan got upgraded automatically without me agreeing to it.

alt: We finally got fibre connected last week, and it's way faster.

alt: My fridge is still under warranty, so the repair won't cost anything.
point: 免费修 → will be repaired for free，冰箱做主语

point: …贴的 → were laid by；贴得烂 → are badly done

zh: 我的驾照申请还在处理，大概还要两周。

alt: They're still processing my licence application; it should take another two weeks.
point: 在处理 → is still being processed，进行时被动

alt: They misspelt my name on the form, so I need to fill out another one.

alt: You need to attach a copy of your passport to every application.
point: 要附上 → must be attached to，规定常用被动

zh: 昨晚大风刮倒了好几棵树，路被堵了。

alt: Last night's wind brought down several trees and blocked the road.
point: 刮倒 → were blown down，blow 的过去分词是 blown

point: 受鼓舞 → was encouraged by，后接 how 从句

zh: 我的笔记本拿去修了，所以今天用的是借来的电脑。

point: 拿去修 → having my laptop repaired，have + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 他们已经联系过我的推荐人了，应该快有消息了。

zh: 面试的时候他们跟我说薪资还可以谈。

point: 他们跟我说 → I was told that，被告知用被动

zh: 我的简历被HR直接转给了技术经理。

point: 被转给 → was passed on to，pass on 被动别漏 on

zh: 这门课的成绩有一半是看期末考试的。

zh: 作业迟交会扣分，除非你有医生证明。

zh: 这个周末我们请人来洗地毯。

alt: We're having someone in to clean the carpets this weekend.
point: 请人来洗 → getting the carpets cleaned，get + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 草坪好久没割了，真的得割一下了。

point: 好久没割 → hasn't been mowed for ages；得割 → needs doing

zh: 我把衣服晾在外面，结果全被雨淋湿了。
en: I left the washing out, and it all got rained on.

point: 被雨淋 → got rained on，不及物动词也能 get + 过去分词 + on

zh: 要是房子没打扫干净，押金可能会被扣一部分。

alt: You might lose some of your bond if the house isn't left clean.
point: 押金被扣 → could be kept；没打扫干净 → isn't cleaned

zh: 我们搬进来的时候，地毯已经被前租客弄脏了。

zh: 房东让我们月底之前把车库清空。

zh: 我们的信箱好像被人翻过，少了好几封信。

point: 好像被翻过 → seems to have been gone through，完成式被动不定式

zh: 隔壁的树枝掉下来，把我们的围栏砸坏了一段。

alt: A branch from next door's tree came down and damaged part of our fence.
point: 砸坏 → got damaged by，主语换成围栏

zh: 我们漏交了一期电费，差点被断电。
en: We nearly had our power cut off because we'd missed a payment.
alt: Our power almost got disconnected because we'd missed a payment.
point: 差点被断电 → nearly had our power cut off，have 表遭遇

zh: 我的电话被转了五次，最后还是没人能帮我。
en: I got transferred five times, and in the end nobody could help me.

point: 电话被转 → got transferred，人做主语

zh: 智能电表装好以后，就不用再有人上门抄表了。
en: Once the smart meter's installed, it won't need to be read in person any more.
alt: After the smart meter goes in, nobody will need to come and read it.
point: 装好以后 → once it's installed；抄表 → need to be read

zh: 我们打算找电工把整栋房子的电线重新布一遍。

alt: We're having an electrician rewire the whole house.
point: 找人重新布线 → getting the house rewired，使役被动

zh: 洗碗机修好还不到两个星期又坏了。
en: The dishwasher broke down again less than two weeks after it had been repaired.
alt: The dishwasher packed up again under two weeks after being fixed.
point: 修好之后 → after it had been repaired，过去完成被动

zh: 这个报价不含人工费，材料要另外算。
en: Labour isn't included in this quote, and materials will be charged separately.
alt: This quote doesn't cover labour, and materials are extra.
point: 不含 → isn't included；另外算 → will be charged separately

zh: 这件外套打折打到五十块，被我抢到了。
en: I grabbed this jacket after it had been marked down to fifty dollars.
alt: I snapped up this jacket once it was reduced to fifty bucks.
point: 打折 → had been marked down，商品做主语

zh: 收银员多收了我的钱，我回到家才发现。
en: I didn't realise I'd been overcharged until I got home.
alt: I only noticed they'd overcharged me once I got home.
point: 多收了我钱 → I'd been overcharged，人做主语

zh: 我的网上订单被取消了，因为网站上的库存标错了。
en: My online order was cancelled because the item had been listed as in stock by mistake.
alt: They cancelled my online order because the website wrongly showed it as in stock.
point: 被取消 → was cancelled；标错 → had been listed by mistake

zh: 我们等了半天都没人来点菜，估计是把我们忘了。
en: We've been waiting ages to order, and I think we've been forgotten.
alt: We've been sitting here for ages and I reckon they've forgotten about us.
point: 把我们忘了 → we've been forgotten，人做被动主语

zh: 这道菜可以做成无麸质的，跟服务员说一声就行。
en: This dish can be made gluten-free if you let the staff know.
alt: They can do this dish gluten-free if you ask.
point: 可以做成 → can be made gluten-free，make + 形容词的被动

zh: 我们一进门就被带到了靠窗的位子。
en: We were shown to a table by the window as soon as we walked in.
alt: As soon as we arrived, they took us to a window table.
point: 被带到座位 → were shown to a table，show 的被动

zh: 我的银行卡在国外被人刷了好几笔，我完全不知道。
en: Several payments were made on my card overseas without my knowledge.
alt: Someone used my card for a few payments overseas without me knowing.
point: 被盗刷 → payments were made on my card，交易做主语

zh: 这笔钱会在三个工作日内转到你的账户。
en: The money will be transferred to your account within three working days.
alt: You'll get the money in your account within three working days.
point: 转到账户 → will be transferred to，钱做主语

zh: 银行收了我一笔账户费，之前根本没人跟我说过。
en: I've been charged an account fee that nobody told me about.
alt: The bank's hit me with an account fee I was never told about.
point: 收了我费用 → I've been charged a fee，双宾语被动

zh: 我的护照得续了，还得重新拍照片。
en: I need to get my passport renewed, and I'll have to get new photos taken.
alt: My passport needs renewing, and I'll need new photos done.
point: 续护照 → get my passport renewed；拍照 → get photos taken

zh: 移民局让我补交几份材料，居留申请才能继续。
en: I've been asked to provide more documents before my residence application can go ahead.
alt: Immigration want more documents from me before they can process my residence application.
point: 让我补交 → I've been asked to provide，省掉「移民局」

zh: 他们说我的信在路上寄丢了，会再寄一封。
en: Apparently my letter got lost in the post, so another one's being sent.
alt: They said my letter went missing in the post and they're sending a new one.
point: 寄丢了 → got lost in the post；再寄 → is being sent

zh: 我下周去给手腕拍个X光，看看是不是骨折了。
en: I'm getting my wrist X-rayed next week to see if it's broken.
alt: I'm having an X-ray on my wrist next week to check if it's broken.
point: 去拍X光 → getting my wrist X-rayed，使役被动

zh: 我的处方得让医生续开，不然药房不给拿药。
en: My prescription needs to be renewed by the doctor before the pharmacy will give me any more.
alt: I need the doctor to renew my prescription before I can get more from the pharmacy.
point: 让医生续开 → needs to be renewed by the doctor

zh: 我在急诊等了四个小时才有医生来看。
en: I waited four hours in ED before I got seen by a doctor.
alt: I was in the emergency department for four hours before a doctor saw me.
point: 有医生来看 → got seen by a doctor，病人做主语

zh: 邻居家车库着火了，消防员一到几分钟就扑灭了。
en: Our neighbour's garage caught fire, but it was put out within minutes of the fire brigade arriving.
alt: The fire in our neighbour's garage was put out minutes after the firefighters got there.
point: 扑灭 → was put out，put out 的被动

zh: 那个司机当场就被抓了，因为他喝了酒。
en: The driver was arrested on the spot because he'd been drinking.
alt: Police arrested the driver on the spot for drink-driving.
point: 被抓 → was arrested，不是 was caught 也可

zh: 我丢的手机被人捡到，交到警察局了。
en: My lost phone was found and handed in to the police station.
alt: Someone found my phone and handed it in at the police station.
point: 捡到交到 → was found and handed in，两个被动并列

zh: 我今天去给车换机油，顺便检查一下刹车。
en: I'm getting my car's oil changed today and having the brakes checked too.
alt: My car's going in for an oil change today, and they're checking the brakes too.
point: 换机油 → get the oil changed；检查刹车 → have the brakes checked

zh: 我停车超时了，车上被贴了罚单。
en: My car got ticketed because I'd overstayed the time limit.
alt: I got a parking ticket because I stayed past the time limit.
point: 被贴罚单 → got ticketed，ticket 作动词

zh: 这条高速正在扩建，预计至少要修两年。
en: The motorway's being widened, and the work's expected to take at least two years.
alt: They're widening the motorway, which should take at least two years.
point: 预计 → is expected to，常用被动表达预测

zh: 我们的酒店房间被重复预订了，只好换了一家。
en: Our hotel room had been double-booked, so we had to go somewhere else.
alt: The hotel had double-booked our room, so we had to find another place.
point: 重复预订 → had been double-booked，过去完成被动

zh: 我们一下飞机就被要求申报带的所有食物。
en: As soon as we got off the plane, we were asked to declare all our food.
alt: The moment we landed, we had to declare all the food we'd brought.
point: 被要求申报 → were asked to declare

zh: 这个团的费用包含住宿和早餐，但机票不包含。
en: Accommodation and breakfast are included in the tour price, but flights aren't.
alt: The tour price covers accommodation and breakfast, but not flights.
point: 包含 → are included in，后半句省略 aren't included

zh: 这条步道去年重新修过，现在好走多了。
en: This track was upgraded last year, so it's much easier to walk now.
alt: They upgraded this track last year, and it's a lot easier now.
point: 重新修过 → was upgraded，步道做主语

zh: 牌子上提醒游客不要靠近悬崖边。
en: Visitors are warned to stay away from the cliff edge.
alt: The sign warns people to keep back from the cliff edge.
point: 提醒游客 → visitors are warned to，告示常用被动

zh: 半夜我们的帐篷被风吹倒了。
en: Our tent got blown over by the wind in the middle of the night.
alt: The wind knocked our tent over in the middle of the night.
point: 被风吹倒 → got blown over，不是 was blown down 也可

zh: 健身房正在翻修，所以会员都被安排去另一家分店。
en: The gym's being refurbished, so members are being sent to another branch.
alt: The gym's closed for a refit, so they're sending members to another branch.
point: 正在翻修 → is being refurbished，两个进行时被动

zh: 他训练的时候受伤了，下周的比赛会换人替他。
en: He got hurt at training, so he'll be replaced for next week's game.
alt: He picked up an injury at training, so someone else will play next week.
point: 受伤 → got hurt；换人替他 → he'll be replaced

zh: 我们这场被对手打得落花流水。
en: We got absolutely thrashed by the other team.
alt: The other team absolutely hammered us.
point: 被打得惨败 → got thrashed，口语强调用 absolutely

zh: 这个读书会每个月由不同的成员来组织。
en: The book club is run by a different member each month.
alt: A different member runs the book club each month.
point: 由…来组织 → is run by，run 表示主持、运营

zh: 这家老电影院要拆了，改建成公寓。
en: This old cinema's going to be pulled down and turned into apartments.
alt: They're knocking down this old cinema to build apartments.
point: 要拆 → is going to be pulled down；改建 → turned into

zh: 我得把吉他拿去换弦，顺便调一下。
en: I need to get my guitar restrung and properly tuned.
alt: My guitar needs new strings and a proper tune-up.
point: 拿去换弦 → get my guitar restrung，使役被动

zh: 她的名字我老是叫错，已经被她纠正好几次了。
en: I keep getting her name wrong, and I've been corrected a few times now.
alt: I keep mixing up her name, and she's had to correct me several times.
point: 被纠正 → I've been corrected，完成时被动

zh: 派对的照片被他发到网上了，也没问过我们。
en: Our photos from the party got posted online without anyone asking us.
alt: He put our party photos online without checking with us.
point: 被发到网上 → got posted online，照片做主语

zh: 我是被一个朋友劝着去报了即兴表演课的。
en: I got talked into joining an improv class by a friend.
alt: A friend talked me into signing up for an improv class.
point: 被劝着去 → got talked into + -ing，into 后接动名词

zh: 我们的婚礼请柬上周已经寄出去了。
en: Our wedding invitations were sent out last week.
alt: We sent out our wedding invitations last week.
point: 寄出去 → were sent out，请柬做主语

zh: 葬礼周四举行，结束后会在家里招待大家喝茶吃点东西。
en: The funeral will be held on Thursday, and refreshments will be served at the house afterwards.
alt: The funeral's on Thursday, with food and drinks at the house afterwards.
point: 举行 → will be held；招待 → will be served

zh: 这些红包是我爸妈从国内寄过来的。
en: These red envelopes were sent over from China by my parents.
alt: My parents posted these red envelopes over from China.
point: …寄过来的 → were sent over by，是…的 → 被动

zh: 学校请家长去帮忙组织运动会。
en: Parents have been asked to help out at the school athletics day.
alt: The school's asked parents to give a hand at athletics day.
point: 学校请家长 → parents have been asked to

zh: 我是独生子，从小有点被惯坏了。
en: I'm an only child, so I got a bit spoilt growing up.
alt: As an only child, I was pretty spoilt as a kid.
point: 被惯坏 → got spoilt，英式拼写 spoilt

zh: 孩子的疫苗记录本弄丢了，得去诊所补一份。
en: My son's vaccination record has been lost, so we need to get a copy from the clinic.
alt: We've lost our son's immunisation record, so we have to ask the clinic for a copy.
point: 弄丢了 → has been lost，记录本做主语

zh: 我们的猫植入了芯片，万一走丢也能找回来。
en: Our cat's been microchipped, so she can be traced if she ever gets lost.
alt: Our cat has a microchip, so we can find her if she goes missing.
point: 植入芯片 → has been microchipped；能找回 → can be traced

zh: 我要出门几天，狗送去寄养了。
en: I'm going away, so the dog's being boarded at a kennel.
alt: I'm away for a few days, so the dog's staying at a kennel.
point: 送去寄养 → is being boarded，进行时被动

zh: 狗的毛太长了，得带它去修剪一下。
en: I need to get the dog groomed because his coat's far too long.
alt: The dog needs a groom because his fur's way too long.
point: 带它去修剪 → get the dog groomed，使役被动

zh: 当着那么多人被拿来开玩笑，我心里挺不舒服的。
en: I didn't like being made fun of in front of everyone.
alt: It upset me that they made fun of me in front of everyone.
point: 被拿来开玩笑 → being made fun of，别漏 of

zh: 能被身边的人理解，我觉得很安慰。
en: It's comforting to be understood by the people around me.
alt: It means a lot that the people around me understand me.
point: 被理解 → to be understood，不定式被动

zh: 这个消息把我吓懵了，到现在都还没缓过来。
en: I was stunned by the news, and I still haven't got over it.
alt: The news knocked me sideways, and I'm still not over it.
point: 把我吓懵 → I was stunned by，换「我」做主语

zh: 我刚接到通知，客户演示提前到周一了，所以我们周末可能得加班把幻灯片做完。
en: I've just been told the client demo's been brought forward to Monday, so we might have to work over the weekend to get the slides done.
alt: I've just heard the client demo's moved up to Monday, so we may need to work this weekend to finish the slides.
point: 接到通知 → I've been told；提前 → has been brought forward

zh: 提前说一声：周六晚上服务器要下线维护，到时候所有系统会有几个小时用不了。
en: Just a heads-up: the servers will be taken offline for maintenance on Saturday night, so none of the systems will be available for a few hours.
alt: Heads-up: the servers are going down for maintenance on Saturday night, and everything will be unavailable for a few hours.
point: 下线维护 → will be taken offline for maintenance

zh: 我打电话想订周六的位子，结果对方说那天晚上整个店都被一个公司聚会包了。
en: I rang to book for Saturday, but I was told the whole place had been booked out for a work function.
alt: When I called about Saturday, they said a company had booked the whole restaurant for the night.
point: 对方说 → I was told；被包场 → had been booked out

zh: 他是在一场学校比赛里被球探看中的，十八岁就拿到了职业合同。
en: He was spotted by a scout at a school game and was offered a professional contract at eighteen.
alt: A scout saw him playing in a school game, and he signed a pro contract at eighteen.
point: 被看中 → was spotted by；拿到合同 → was offered

zh: 他们说我上周退回去的靴子已经收到了，可是钱到现在还没退回我卡上。
en: They say the boots I sent back last week have been received, but the money still hasn't been put back on my card.
alt: They've confirmed they got the boots I returned last week, but I still haven't been refunded.
point: 已经收到 → have been received；还没退 → hasn't been put back

zh: 我们订的那班渡轮因为风浪太大取消了，船公司把我们改到了明天早上第一班。
en: Our ferry was cancelled because of rough seas, and we've been moved onto the first sailing tomorrow morning.
alt: The ferry got cancelled due to rough seas, so they've put us on the first one tomorrow morning.
point: 把我们改到 → we've been moved onto，乘客做主语

zh: 医生把我转给了专科，但公立的要排三个月，所以我在考虑要不要自费看。
en: I've been referred to a specialist, but the public waiting list is three months, so I'm thinking about going private.
alt: My GP's referred me to a specialist, but there's a three-month wait in the public system, so I might pay to go private.
point: 把我转给专科 → I've been referred to a specialist

zh: 车库里那堆旧家具周末被慈善二手店的人拉走了，我们终于腾出地方了。
en: That pile of old furniture in our garage got picked up by the op shop at the weekend, so we've finally got some space.
alt: The op shop came and took away all the old furniture from our garage at the weekend, so there's finally some room.
point: 被拉走 → got picked up by；二手慈善店叫 op shop

zh: 上次聚会的时候，大家问了我一大堆关于中国的问题，搞得我像在接受采访一样。
en: At the last get-together I got asked so many questions about China that it felt like I was being interviewed.
alt: Everyone asked me so much about China at the last catch-up that it felt like an interview.
point: 大家问我 → I got asked；像在接受采访 → was being interviewed

zh: 我被一个冒充银行的人骗了，现在银行跟我说这笔钱可能追不回来了。
en: I was scammed by someone pretending to be from my bank, and now I've been told the money might not be recoverable.
alt: Someone posing as my bank scammed me, and now the bank says I might not get the money back.
point: 被骗 → was scammed by；银行跟我说 → I've been told

zh: 我想确认一下我有没有进入最后一轮名单，因为我手上还有另一个offer，周五前得答复。
en: I just wanted to check whether I've been shortlisted, because I've been offered another role and need to reply by Friday.
alt: Could I check if I've made the shortlist? I've got another offer that I need to answer by Friday.
point: 进入名单 → have been shortlisted；有 offer → have been offered

zh: 是猎头主动找的我，他说这个职位不公开招聘，只通过内部推荐。
en: I was approached by a recruiter, and he said the role isn't being advertised publicly and is only filled through referrals.
alt: A recruiter reached out to me and said the job isn't advertised; they only fill it through referrals.
point: 主动找我 → I was approached by；不公开招聘 → isn't being advertised

zh: 合同已经发到我邮箱了，不过试用期那一条我想先谈一谈再签。
en: The contract's been emailed through, but I'd like to discuss the trial period clause before anything's signed.
alt: They've emailed me the contract, but I want to talk about the trial period before I sign.
point: 发到邮箱 → has been emailed；签前 → before anything's signed

zh: 听说这门课明年要砍掉了，因为报名的人太少，所以想上的话今年得赶紧报。
en: I've heard this course is being dropped next year because not enough people enrolled, so if you want to do it, get in quick.
alt: Apparently they're cutting this course next year due to low numbers, so enrol now if you're keen.
point: 要砍掉 → is being dropped，进行时被动表计划

zh: 考试时所有手机都要交上来，谁被发现带了手机，试卷就作废。
en: All phones have to be handed in during the exam, and anyone who's caught with one will have their paper disqualified.
alt: Phones must be handed in for the exam, and if you're caught with one, your paper won't count.
point: 被发现 → who's caught with；试卷作废 → have their paper disqualified

zh: 我的学分转换申请批了，所以我可以跳过第一年，直接读二年级。
en: My credit transfer's been approved, so I can skip first year and go straight into second year.
alt: They've accepted my credit transfer, so I can go straight into second year.
point: 申请批了 → has been approved，申请做主语

zh: 房东发邮件说下周二有人来检查烟雾报警器，我们不在家的话他们会用备用钥匙进来。
en: The landlord emailed to say the smoke alarms are being checked next Tuesday, and they'll be let in with the spare key if we're out.
alt: The landlord says someone's checking the smoke alarms next Tuesday and will use the spare key if nobody's home.
point: 有人来检查 → are being checked；用钥匙进 → they'll be let in

zh: 我们已经申请了三套房子都被拒了，中介说现在每套房都有几十个人抢。
en: We've been turned down for three flats now, and the agent says each place is getting dozens of applications.
alt: We've been rejected for three rentals so far, and the agent says there are dozens of applicants for every place.
point: 被拒 → have been turned down for，介词用 for

zh: 我们有个室友要搬走了，这周末会有人来看他的房间，大家尽量把公共区域收拾一下。
en: One of our flatmates is moving out and his room's being shown this weekend, so could everyone tidy up the shared areas?
alt: A flatmate's leaving and people are coming to see his room this weekend, so can we all tidy the common areas?
point: 有人来看房间 → his room's being shown，房间做主语

zh: 我们这条街的人都被邀请周六参加社区清洁，结束以后还有烧烤。
en: Everyone on our street's been invited to a clean-up on Saturday, and a barbecue's being put on afterwards.
alt: The whole street's been invited to a clean-up day on Saturday, with a barbecue afterwards.
point: 被邀请 → has been invited to；有烧烤 → is being put on

zh: 隔壁的派对昨晚一直闹到凌晨三点，最后还是警察来叫停的。
en: Next door's party went on until three in the morning, and in the end it was shut down by the police.
alt: The party next door kept going till 3am, and the police eventually came and shut it down.
point: 被叫停 → was shut down by the police，shut down 的被动

zh: 我们家的垃圾桶又被人拿去用了，里面塞满了不知道谁家的垃圾。
en: Our wheelie bin's been used by someone else again, and it's been stuffed full of other people's rubbish.
alt: Someone's been using our wheelie bin again, and now it's crammed with their rubbish.
point: 被人用 → has been used by；塞满 → has been stuffed full of

zh: 你好，我想问一下我们家的网为什么从周一开始就被限速了，我们根本没超流量。
en: Hi, I'm calling to find out why our broadband's been slowed down since Monday, because we haven't gone over our data.
alt: Hi, I'd like to know why our internet speed's been throttled since Monday when we haven't used up our data.
point: 被限速 → has been slowed down / throttled，打电话的开场白

zh: 上个月电费是估算的，因为抄表员进不了我们院子，结果多算了不少钱。
en: Last month's power bill was estimated because the meter reader couldn't get into our yard, so we've been overcharged quite a bit.
alt: They estimated last month's power bill because the reader couldn't access the meter, and they've charged us way too much.
point: 是估算的 → was estimated；多算钱 → we've been overcharged

zh: 我们搬家的时候忘了停掉旧房子的燃气，结果被收了两个月的钱，我们人都不在那儿。
en: We forgot to cancel the gas at our old place when we moved, so we've been billed for two months we weren't even there.
alt: We didn't cancel the gas at the old house after moving, and they've charged us for two months we didn't live there.
point: 被收钱 → we've been billed for，人做主语

zh: 三家报价我们选了最便宜的，结果活干得一塌糊涂，现在得找人重做。
en: We went with the cheapest of three quotes, but the job was done so badly that it'll have to be redone.
alt: We picked the cheapest quote, but the work was so bad we need to get it done again.
point: 活干得烂 → was done badly；得重做 → will have to be redone

zh: 电工说我们家的配电箱太老了，必须换掉，不然保险可能不赔。
en: The electrician said our switchboard's so old that it has to be replaced, or we might not be covered by our insurance.
alt: According to the electrician, the switchboard needs replacing or our insurance might not cover us.
point: 必须换 → has to be replaced；保险赔 → be covered by insurance

zh: 屋檐的排水槽被树叶堵住了，一下雨水就漫出来，得找人来清一下。
en: The gutters have been blocked by leaves, so they overflow whenever it rains, and they really need to be cleared out.
alt: Leaves have clogged up the gutters, so they spill over every time it rains and need cleaning out.
point: 被堵住 → have been blocked by；得清 → need to be cleared out

zh: 我的签证申请交了一个多月了，到现在都没人处理，我想问问是不是被漏掉了。
en: My visa application was submitted over a month ago and still hasn't been looked at, so I wanted to check it hasn't been missed.
alt: I sent in my visa application more than a month ago and nobody's touched it yet, so I'm checking it hasn't fallen through the cracks.
point: 没人处理 → hasn't been looked at；被漏掉 → has been missed

zh: 我在网上约了周四上午去换驾照，可确认邮件上的时间被改成下午了。
en: I booked online to swap my licence on Thursday morning, but the confirmation says it's been changed to the afternoon.
alt: I made an online booking for Thursday morning to convert my licence, but the confirmation email shows the afternoon instead.
point: 被改成 → has been changed to，预约做主语
