zh: 我上个月递交的建筑许可申请好像还没受理，能告诉我现在进展到哪一步了吗？
en: The building consent application I lodged last month doesn't appear to have been processed yet; could you advise where it's up to?
alt: It seems my building consent application from last month hasn't been dealt with yet, so could you update me on its progress?
point: 好像还没受理 → doesn't appear to have been processed

zh: 我已经按要求补交了体检报告，希望我的申请能尽快得到处理。
en: I've now submitted the medical certificate as requested, and I'd be grateful if my application could be progressed as soon as possible.
alt: The medical certificate you asked for has now been sent, so I'd appreciate my application moving forward promptly.
point: 按要求 → as requested；希望被处理 → could be progressed

zh: 我的包裹以「地址不详」为由被退回了寄件人，可我核对过，地址写得完全正确。
en: My parcel was returned to the sender as 'address unknown', even though I've checked and the address was written correctly.
alt: The parcel was sent back marked 'address unknown', but the address on it was correct.
point: 被退回 → was returned to the sender；写对了 → was written correctly

zh: 我上个月工作时受了伤，也提交了理赔，可到现在都没批下来，治疗费一直是我自己垫付的。
en: I was injured at work last month and lodged a claim, but it still hasn't been approved, so I've been paying for treatment myself.
alt: My claim for a workplace injury last month is still awaiting approval, and in the meantime I've been covering treatment costs myself.
point: 受伤 → was injured；没批下来 → hasn't been approved

zh: 我父亲的手术在最后一刻被取消了，也没人给任何解释，我们想知道新的日期什么时候能定下来。
en: My father's surgery was cancelled at the last minute without any explanation, and we'd like to know when a new date will be confirmed.
alt: Dad's operation was called off at the last minute with no reason given, so we'd like to know when it'll be rescheduled.
point: 被取消 → was cancelled；日期定下来 → will be confirmed

zh: 药房给我的药跟处方上写的不一样，幸好我吃之前发现了这个错误。
en: I was given a different medication from the one on my prescription; fortunately, the mistake was picked up before I took any.
alt: The pharmacy dispensed the wrong medication, but luckily the error was noticed before I took it.
point: 给我的药 → I was given；发现错误 → the mistake was picked up

zh: 我想报一起盗窃案：我家的工具棚昨晚被撬了，里面大概两千块的工具都被偷走了。
en: I'd like to report a burglary: our garden shed was broken into last night, and around two thousand dollars' worth of tools were taken.
alt: I'm reporting a theft: someone broke into our shed overnight and took roughly two thousand dollars' worth of tools.
point: 被撬 → was broken into；被偷走 → were taken

zh: 地震后我们家的烟囱裂了，工程师建议拆掉，我想知道这笔费用保险是否能赔。
en: Our chimney was cracked in the earthquake and an engineer has advised that it be removed, so I'd like to know whether the cost will be covered.
alt: The quake cracked our chimney, and an engineer says it should come down, so I'm asking whether our policy covers the removal.
point: advise that it be removed；费用能赔 → will be covered

zh: 事故发生时我就在现场，看到那辆车闯了红灯，需要的话我愿意配合作证。
en: I witnessed the accident and saw the car run the red light, and I'm happy to be contacted if a statement is needed.
alt: I saw the crash and the car going through the red light, so feel free to contact me if you need a statement.
point: 愿意被联系 → happy to be contacted，不定式被动

zh: 我对这张停车罚单有异议，因为当时的标志被树枝挡住了，根本看不清。
en: I'm writing to dispute this parking infringement, as the sign was obscured by overhanging branches and couldn't be read.
alt: I'd like to challenge this parking fine because branches were covering the sign and it wasn't legible.
point: 被挡住 → was obscured by；看不清 → couldn't be read

zh: 我的车在你们店保养完第二天就又出了同样的问题，我希望你们能免费重新检查。
en: The same fault reappeared the day after my car was serviced at your garage, so I'd expect it to be re-inspected free of charge.
alt: The problem came back the day after you serviced my car, so I'd like it looked at again at no cost.
point: 保养 → was serviced；重新检查 → expect it to be re-inspected

zh: 我的车在停车场被撞了，对方留了联系方式，请问理赔该怎么申请？
en: My car was hit in a car park, and the other driver left their details, so could you advise how a claim should be lodged?
alt: Someone hit my car in a car park and left their contact details; how do I go about making a claim?
point: 被撞 → was hit；理赔怎么申请 → how a claim should be lodged

zh: 我们的航班延误了九个小时，其间没有提供任何餐食或住宿，我希望能得到合理的赔偿。
en: Our flight was delayed by nine hours and no meals or accommodation were provided, so I'd like to request appropriate compensation.
alt: We were delayed nine hours without being offered food or a hotel, and I'm seeking fair compensation.
point: 没有提供 → were provided 的否定，主语是餐食住宿

zh: 我们预订时你们保证是海景房，可实际给我们的房间正对着停车场。
en: We were assured at booking that our room would have a sea view, but the room we were given overlooked the car park.
alt: We'd been promised a sea-view room when we booked, but ours looked straight out over the car park.
point: 你们保证 → we were assured；给我们的房间 → the room we were given

zh: 我的相机在旅途中被偷了，警方报告已经附上，请问理赔大概多久能处理完？
en: My camera was stolen during the trip, and the police report is attached; could you tell me how long the claim will take to be processed?
alt: My camera was stolen while travelling, and I've attached the police report; how long will the claim take?
point: 被偷 → was stolen；处理完 → take to be processed

zh: 这条步道上有一座桥被洪水冲走了，到现在都没立警示牌，非常危险。
en: One of the bridges on this track was washed away in the flood, and no warning signs have been put up, which is extremely dangerous.
alt: A bridge on this track was swept away by floodwater, yet there are still no warning signs, which is a serious hazard.
point: 被冲走 → was washed away；没立牌子 → no signs have been put up

zh: 我们到了以后发现预订的营位已经被别人占了，营地管理员也没能给出别的方案。
en: When we arrived, the campsite we'd booked had already been taken by another group, and the warden was unable to offer an alternative.
alt: Our booked site was already occupied by another group when we got there, and the warden couldn't offer us anywhere else.
point: 被别人占了 → had already been taken by，过去完成被动

zh: 公园里的游乐设施被人恶意破坏了，希望你们尽快派人修理，免得孩子受伤。
en: The playground equipment in our local park has been vandalised, and I'd ask that it be repaired promptly before a child gets hurt.
alt: Someone's vandalised the playground in our park, so I'd urge you to fix it quickly before a child is injured.
point: 被恶意破坏 → has been vandalised；孩子受伤 → gets hurt

zh: 我三个月前就书面申请取消会员了，可账户还是每周被扣款。
en: I requested in writing three months ago that my membership be cancelled, yet I'm still being charged every week.
alt: I asked in writing three months ago to cancel my membership, but you're still taking payments weekly.
point: 仍被扣款 → I'm still being charged，进行时被动

zh: 经委员会讨论决定，本赛季比赛费将上调，具体金额会在下周的年度大会上公布。
en: Following a committee discussion, it's been decided that match fees will be increased this season, and the amount will be announced at next week's AGM.
alt: The committee has decided to raise match fees this season, and the new amount will be confirmed at next week's AGM.
point: 经讨论决定 → it's been decided that；公布 → will be announced

zh: 我儿子训练时受了伤，但教练当时没通知家长，我认为这件事需要认真对待。
en: My son was injured at training, but we weren't informed by the coach at the time, and I feel this needs to be taken seriously.
alt: My son got hurt at training and the coach didn't let us know, which I think is a serious matter.
point: 没通知家长 → we weren't informed；认真对待 → be taken seriously

zh: 演唱会取消已经一个月了，可我的票钱到现在还没退回来。
en: It's been a month since the concert was cancelled, but the cost of my tickets still hasn't been refunded.
alt: The concert was called off a month ago, and I'm still waiting for my ticket refund.
point: 票钱没退 → hasn't been refunded，钱做主语

zh: 我收到了逾期罚款通知，但那本书两个星期前就已经放进还书箱了。
en: I've received an overdue notice, but the book was actually returned to the drop box two weeks ago.
alt: I've been sent an overdue notice, even though I put the book in the returns box a fortnight ago.
point: 已经还了 → was returned，书做主语

zh: 我想申请加入贵摄影协会，请问申请人是否需要由现有会员推荐？
en: I'd like to apply to join your photography society; could you let me know whether applicants need to be nominated by an existing member?
alt: I'm interested in joining your photography club, and I'd like to know if I need an existing member to nominate me.
point: 由会员推荐 → need to be nominated by

zh: 很荣幸受邀在这次活动上发言，我会提前把讲稿发给您审阅。
en: I'm honoured to have been invited to speak at the event, and I'll send my notes through beforehand so they can be reviewed.
alt: Thank you for inviting me to speak; I'll forward my notes ahead of time for you to look over.
point: 受邀 → to have been invited，完成式不定式被动

zh: 请注意，本月聚会改到社区中心举行，因为原来的场地那天被别的活动订了。
en: Please note that this month's meetup has been moved to the community centre, as the original venue has been booked for another event.
alt: This month's meetup will now be at the community centre, since the usual venue is taken for another event that day.
point: 改到 → has been moved to；被订了 → has been booked for

zh: 我注意到你们在宣传材料上用了我的照片，事先没征得我同意，请尽快删除。
en: I've noticed that a photo of me has been used in your promotional material without my consent, and I'd ask that it be removed immediately.
alt: You've used my photo in your promotional material without permission, so please take it down straight away.
point: 被使用 → has been used；ask that it be removed

zh: 我们在贵场地订了下个月的婚宴，结果刚接到通知说因为装修用不了了，我们非常失望。
en: We'd booked your venue for our wedding reception next month, and we've only just been informed that it's unavailable due to renovations.
alt: We had your venue booked for our reception next month, and we've just been told it can't be used because of renovations.
point: 接到通知 → we've been informed，正式邮件用 inform

zh: 仪式结束后会在教堂大厅为来宾准备茶点，家属希望大家以捐款代替献花。
en: Refreshments will be served in the church hall after the service, and the family has requested that donations be made in lieu of flowers.
alt: After the service, refreshments will be provided in the church hall, and the family asks for donations instead of flowers.
point: 准备茶点 → will be served；request that donations be made

zh: 我想申请春节期间请两天假，我的工作已经安排好由同事暂时接手。
en: I'd like to request two days' leave over Chinese New Year; arrangements have been made for my work to be covered by a colleague.
alt: I'm requesting two days off for Chinese New Year, and a colleague has agreed to cover my work.
point: 安排好 → arrangements have been made；由同事接手 → to be covered by

zh: 我们希望周五下午能让女儿提前离校，去参加家里的婚礼。
en: We'd like to request that our daughter be excused from school on Friday afternoon so she can attend a family wedding.
alt: Could our daughter please be excused from Friday afternoon classes to attend a family wedding?
point: 让她离校 → request that she be excused，学校请假用语

zh: 我们收到通知说幼儿园下学期要涨费，可入园的时候我们被告知两年内费用不变。
en: We've been notified that daycare fees will go up next term, although we were told on enrolment that they'd be fixed for two years.
alt: We've received notice of a fee increase next term, despite being told at enrolment that fees were locked in for two years.
point: 收到通知 → we've been notified；被告知 → we were told

zh: 我们注意到儿子的成绩单上有几门课没有评语，想问一下是不是不小心漏掉了。
en: We noticed that several subjects on our son's report had no comments, and we wondered whether these might have been left off by mistake.
alt: Some subjects on our son's report are missing comments, and we're wondering if they were accidentally left out.
point: 可能被漏掉 → might have been left off，情态完成被动

zh: 狗的登记费我们按时交了，却还是收到了逾期通知，我想可能是误发的。
en: We paid our dog registration fee on time but have still received an overdue notice, which I assume was sent in error.
alt: Our dog registration was paid on time, so the overdue notice we've received must have been sent by mistake.
point: 误发 → was sent in error，正式说法

zh: 我想正式申请在房子里养一只猫，如果需要，我们搬走时愿意请人专业清洗地毯。
en: I'd like to formally request permission to keep a cat, and we'd be happy to have the carpets professionally cleaned when we leave.
alt: We're writing to ask if we may have a cat at the property, and we'll gladly get the carpets professionally cleaned at the end of the tenancy.
point: 请人清洗 → have the carpets cleaned，使役结构

zh: 我的狗在你们诊所做完手术后伤口感染了，而当时没人告诉我们要注意哪些症状。
en: My dog developed an infection after surgery at your clinic, and we weren't advised what signs to look out for.
alt: Following surgery at your clinic, my dog's wound became infected, and nobody told us what symptoms to watch for.
point: 没人告诉我们 → we weren't advised，advise 的被动

zh: 对于我昨天在会上的发言，我深表歉意，我措辞不当，绝对不是针对个人。
en: I'd like to apologise for my comments in yesterday's meeting; they were poorly worded and certainly weren't intended as a personal criticism.
alt: Please accept my apology for what I said yesterday; it came out badly and wasn't meant personally.
point: 措辞不当 → were poorly worded；不是针对 → weren't intended as

zh: 我想反映一个问题：最近几次开会，我的意见总是被打断或者忽视，这让我的工作很难开展。
en: I'd like to raise a concern: in recent meetings my input has repeatedly been dismissed or talked over, which is making my job difficult.
alt: I want to flag that my contributions in recent meetings keep getting brushed aside or interrupted, and it's affecting my work.
point: 被打断忽视 → has been dismissed or talked over

zh: 得知您母亲去世的消息，我们深感悲痛，所有认识她的人都会深深怀念她。
en: We were deeply saddened to hear of your mother's passing; she'll be greatly missed by everyone who knew her.
alt: We were so sorry to learn of your mother's death, and she will be dearly missed by all who knew her.
point: 深感悲痛 → were saddened；被怀念 → will be missed by

zh: 我不是想推卸责任，但需求是在最后一刻改的，也没人通知我们，所以这事不能全算在我们头上。
en: I'm not trying to pass the buck, but the requirements were changed at the eleventh hour and nobody told us, so it's not entirely on us.
alt: I'm not shifting the blame, but the requirements were changed at the last minute without anyone letting us know, so it's not all our fault.
point: 无主被动 were changed 避免点名；推卸 → pass the buck

zh: 我总觉得最近很多决定都没让我参与，是我想多了，还是我被边缘化了？
en: I get the feeling I'm being kept out of the loop on a lot of decisions lately; am I imagining it, or have I been sidelined?
alt: I've noticed I'm not being included in many decisions lately, so is that just me, or have I been pushed to the side?
point: 不让参与 → being kept out of the loop；边缘化 → been sidelined

zh: 升职名额给了一个才来半年的人，我承认我有点被打了个措手不及。
en: I was passed over for that promotion in favour of someone who's only been here six months, and I'll admit I was a bit blindsided.
alt: They gave the promotion to someone who's been here six months instead of me, and honestly, I didn't see it coming.
point: 没被提拔 → was passed over；措手不及 → was blindsided

zh: 这个系统一看就是赶工拼凑出来的，好多地方都是临时糊上的，出问题只是时间早晚。
en: This system looks like it was thrown together in a rush, and half of it's held together with duct tape, so it's only a matter of time before something breaks.
alt: This system was clearly cobbled together in a hurry, with temporary fixes everywhere, so something's bound to break sooner or later.
point: 拼凑出来 → was thrown together；临时糊上 → held together with tape

zh: 我不想显得太挑剔，但我觉得这个还没测充分，上线之前最好再看一眼。
en: I don't want to be seen as nitpicking, but I'm not sure this has been tested thoroughly enough, so it might be worth another look before it goes live.
alt: Not to be picky, but I doubt this has had enough testing, so maybe we give it another once-over before release.
point: 不想显得 → don't want to be seen as；没测充分 → hasn't been tested

zh: 你说数据都备份好了，那我就信你了，不过万一没备份，我可不想最后背这个锅。
en: I'll take your word that it's all been backed up, but if it turns out it hasn't, I don't want to be left holding the baby.
alt: I'm trusting you that everything's backed up, but if it isn't, I'm not going to be the one who takes the blame.
point: 背锅 → be left holding the baby，英式被动习语

zh: 他们一直说会联系我，可都一个多月了，我怀疑他们早就内定了人，只是在吊着我。
en: They keep saying they'll be in touch, but it's been over a month, and I suspect I'm being strung along because someone's already been lined up.
alt: It's been over a month of 'we'll get back to you', so I reckon they've already got someone in mind and are just keeping me hanging.
point: 被吊着 → being strung along；内定 → has been lined up

zh: 说到缺点，我有时候太容易陷在细节里，不过现在我会有意识地先退一步看全局。
en: If I'm honest, I can get bogged down in the details at times, but I've learnt to step back and look at the bigger picture first.
alt: My weakness is that I sometimes get too caught up in detail, though I now make a point of looking at the big picture first.
point: 陷在细节里 → get bogged down in，面试委婉说缺点

zh: 他们说是「结构调整」，说白了就是把我裁了，不过我本来就想换个环境，也不算坏事。
en: They called it a restructure, but in plain English I was let go; that said, I'd been itching for a change anyway, so it's not the end of the world.
alt: It was dressed up as a restructure, but basically I lost my job, though I'd been wanting a change for a while, so it's no disaster.
point: 被裁 → was let go，比 fired 委婉

zh: 我被分到一个组里，另外两个人什么都不干，全靠我一个人撑，可我又不想去告状。
en: I've been put in a group where the other two aren't pulling their weight, so I'm carrying the whole thing, but I don't want to come across as a snitch.
alt: My group's two other members aren't doing their share, and I'm doing everything, but I don't want to be the one who tells on them.
point: 被分到 → have been put in；不出力 → aren't pulling their weight

zh: 评分老师说我的论文「很大胆」，我猜这是委婉地说「这不是题目要求的」。
en: My essay was described as 'brave' by the marker, which I'm guessing is code for 'this isn't what was asked for'.
alt: The marker called my essay 'brave', which I suspect is a polite way of saying I didn't answer the question.
point: 被评为 → was described as；题目要求的 → what was asked for

zh: 开学第一天老师就点我做自我介绍，我一点准备都没有，完全被问懵了。
en: I got put on the spot on the first day when the tutor asked me to introduce myself, and I was completely caught off guard.
alt: The tutor made me introduce myself on day one without warning, and I was totally unprepared.
point: 被点名 → got put on the spot；措手不及 → caught off guard

zh: 我老公说车库「差不多」收拾好了，我觉得「差不多」这个词被他用得相当宽泛。
en: My husband says the garage has 'more or less' been sorted, though I think 'more or less' is being used pretty loosely there.
alt: According to my husband, the garage is 'more or less' tidy, but I'd say he's stretching the meaning of 'more or less'.
point: 被用得宽泛 → is being used loosely，幽默的进行时被动

zh: 新沙发送来才发现进不了门，只能退回去，早知道应该先量一下门框的。
en: It turned out the new couch wouldn't fit through the door, so it's had to be sent back, and in hindsight the doorway should've been measured first.
alt: The new couch didn't fit through the door and had to go back; we really should have measured the doorway first.
point: 只能退回 → has had to be sent back；早该量 → should've been measured

zh: 我妈念叨了我一晚上家里太乱，说实话，房子确实有一阵子没好好收拾了。
en: I got an earful from Mum all evening about the state of the house, and to be fair, it hadn't been tidied in a while.
alt: Mum went on at me all night about how messy the house was, and fair enough, I hadn't cleaned up in ages.
point: 挨训 → got an earful；没收拾 → hadn't been tidied

zh: 中介说这房子「很有特色」，去看了才知道，意思是七十年代以后就没翻新过。
en: The agent described the place as 'full of character', which turned out to mean nothing's been updated since about 1970.
alt: 'Full of character', the agent said, which apparently meant nothing had been touched since the seventies.
point: 没翻新过 → nothing's been updated，听懂中介的潜台词

zh: 我不想把关系搞僵，但押金扣了四百块，总该给个说法，至少让我们看看发票吧。
en: I don't want to sour things, but if four hundred dollars has been taken out of the bond, we should at least be shown the invoices.
alt: I'd rather not make this awkward, but if they're keeping four hundred dollars of our bond, we deserve to see the invoices.
point: 押金被扣 → has been taken out of；让我们看 → be shown

zh: 之前我们被暗示只要好好住，续约没问题，结果房东突然要卖房，感觉有点被耍了。
en: We were led to believe our lease would be renewed if we looked after the place, so the sudden sale has left us feeling a bit hard done by.
alt: We'd been given the impression we could renew if we kept the place nice, so the surprise sale feels a bit unfair.
point: 被暗示 → were led to believe；觉得吃亏 → hard done by

zh: 我不想多管闲事，但他们家的草好几个月没割了，我又怕被当成那种爱挑刺的邻居。
en: I don't want to stick my nose in, but their lawn hasn't been mowed in months, and I'd hate to be seen as the neighbour who complains about everything.
alt: It's not my business, but their grass hasn't been cut for months, though I don't want to become the street's resident complainer.
point: 怕被当成 → hate to be seen as；没割 → hasn't been mowed

zh: 我们的车位又被人占了，我在挡风玻璃上留了张很客气的纸条，希望对方能领会。
en: Our parking spot's been nabbed again, so I've left a very polite note on the windscreen, and I'm hoping the hint will be taken.
alt: Someone's pinched our parking space again, so I've left a polite note on their windscreen and fingers crossed they get the message.
point: 被占 → has been nabbed；领会暗示 → the hint will be taken

zh: 我被拉进了街道委员会，说好的是「偶尔帮个忙」，结果现在每周都要开会。
en: I got roped into the street committee on the understanding it'd be the odd bit of help, and now I'm in meetings every week.
alt: They talked me onto the street committee saying it'd only be occasional, and now I've got meetings every single week.
point: 被拉进 → got roped into，不情愿被卷入

zh: 我打了三次客服，每次都被转来转去，每个人说法还不一样，感觉就是在跟我踢皮球。
en: I've rung them three times and been passed from pillar to post, with a different story every time, so I feel like I'm getting the runaround.
alt: Three calls later, I've been bounced between departments and told something different each time; it's a total runaround.
point: 被转来转去 → been passed from pillar to post；踢皮球 → the runaround

zh: 当初推销给我的「优惠价」十二个月后会自动涨，这一点签约时他们可是只字未提。
en: The 'special rate' they sold me on goes up automatically after twelve months, which, funnily enough, wasn't mentioned at all when I signed up.
alt: Funnily enough, nobody mentioned when I signed up that the 'special rate' jumps after twelve months.
point: 只字未提 → wasn't mentioned at all，funnily enough 带讽刺

zh: 我不是说一定是谁搞错了，但能不能麻烦帮我看看这笔费用是不是被重复收了？
en: I'm not saying anyone's made a mistake, but would you mind checking whether this charge has been doubled up by accident?
alt: I'm not pointing fingers, but could you check if I've been charged for this twice by mistake?
point: 被重复收 → has been doubled up，委婉不指责人

zh: 水管工说是「小毛病」，修完给了我一张八百块的账单，我总觉得自己被宰了。
en: The plumber called it a quick fix, then handed me an eight-hundred-dollar bill, so I can't help feeling I've been taken for a ride.
alt: The plumber said it was a small job and then charged me eight hundred bucks, so I reckon I've been ripped off.
point: 被宰 → been taken for a ride / ripped off

zh: 这些东西我不太懂，很容易被忽悠着花冤枉钱，你能帮我看看这个报价合不合理吗？
en: I don't know much about this stuff, so I could easily be talked into paying for things I don't need; would you mind casting an eye over this quote?
alt: I'm clueless about this, so I'd be an easy target for upselling; could you have a quick look at this quote for me?
point: 被忽悠 → be talked into + -ing；帮我看 → cast an eye over

zh: 那个漏水上个月说是「修好了」，可昨晚又滴了一夜，看来只是被临时糊弄了一下。
en: That leak was supposedly fixed last month, but it dripped all night again, so it looks like it was just patched up rather than properly sorted.
alt: They claimed the leak was fixed last month, yet it dripped all night, so clearly it was only a band-aid job.
point: 据说修好 → was supposedly fixed；临时糊弄 → was patched up

zh: 他们说这是翻新机，结果才用两天就坏了，我觉得我是被卖了个次品。
en: They said it was refurbished, but it packed up after two days, so I reckon I've been sold a lemon.
alt: It was meant to be refurbished but died within two days, so I think they've palmed off a dud on me.
point: 被卖次品 → been sold a lemon，双宾语被动 + 习语

zh: 我本来只想买双袜子，结果被店员三言两语哄着买了一双三百块的跑鞋，到现在都没想明白。
en: I only went in for a pair of socks, but somehow I got sweet-talked into buying three-hundred-dollar running shoes, and I'm still not sure how it happened.
alt: I popped in for socks and somehow walked out with three-hundred-dollar running shoes; the salesperson was that good.
point: 被哄着买 → got sweet-talked into buying

zh: 我问能不能退货，店员一直推说要问经理，感觉就是在敷衍我，变相说不行。
en: I asked about a return, but I kept being fobbed off with 'I'll have to check with my manager', which felt like a polite way of saying no.
alt: Every time I asked about returning it, I got 'I'll need to ask my manager', which was basically a no in disguise.
point: 被敷衍 → being fobbed off with，英式口语

zh: 我们等了快一个小时，每次问都说「马上就好」，我开始怀疑我们的单根本没下到厨房。
en: We've been waiting nearly an hour and keep being told it's 'just coming', so I'm starting to suspect our order was never put through.
alt: It's been almost an hour of 'it's on its way', and I'm beginning to think our order never made it to the kitchen.
point: 一直被告知 → keep being told；单没下 → was never put through

zh: 我不想小题大做，但账单上好像多了两杯酒，可能是别桌的酒被记到我们这儿了。
en: I don't want to make a fuss, but there seem to be two extra wines on the bill, so I think another table's drinks may have been put on ours.
alt: Sorry to be a pain, but I think a couple of wines from another table might have ended up on our bill.
point: 被记到 → may have been put on，委婉指出错误

zh: 这家店在网上被吹过头了，东西还行，但绝对不值得排一个小时的队。
en: This place has been massively overhyped online; the food's decent enough, but it's definitely not worth queuing an hour for.
alt: The online buzz about this place is overblown; the food's fine, but not worth an hour in the queue.
point: 被吹过头 → has been overhyped，过去分词带评价

zh: 说是「零手续费」，其实汇率被他们悄悄压低了，羊毛出在羊身上。
en: They advertise 'zero fees', but the exchange rate's been quietly marked up, so you're paying for it one way or another.
alt: 'No fees', they say, but they've padded the exchange rate, so you end up paying either way.
point: 汇率被加价 → has been marked up；羊毛出在羊身上 → one way or another

zh: 聚餐的钱是我先垫的，到现在只有一个人转给我，我又不好意思去催其他人。
en: I covered the bill for the group dinner, and so far I've only been paid back by one person, but I feel awkward chasing the others.
alt: I put the group dinner on my card, and only one person's paid me back so far, but I don't like hassling the rest.
point: 还钱给我 → I've been paid back by；催 → chase

zh: 那个投资听着好得不像真的，我劝我爸别被套进去，可我感觉他已经被说动了。
en: That investment sounds too good to be true, and I've warned Dad not to get sucked in, but I've got a feeling he's already been won over.
alt: That investment seems too good to be true, and I've told Dad to steer clear, but I think they've already got him convinced.
point: 被套进去 → get sucked in；被说动 → has been won over

zh: 表上写处理时间四到六周，现在都十周了，我怀疑我的申请被压在谁抽屉底下了。
en: The form said four to six weeks, but it's been ten, so I suspect my application's been buried at the bottom of someone's in-tray.
alt: They quoted four to six weeks and it's now ten, so I reckon my application's gathering dust somewhere.
point: 被压着 → has been buried，夸张的被动说法

zh: 这次他们说要原件，可上次另一个工作人员明明说复印件就行，害我白跑一趟。
en: This time I was told they need originals, though last time I was assured copies would be fine, so I've had a wasted trip.
alt: Now they say they need originals, even though last time someone told me copies were OK, so that was a wasted trip.
point: 被告知 → was told；被保证 → was assured，前后对比

zh: 我不想显得不讲理，但同一份材料已经第三次让我交了，会不会是在系统里弄丢了？
en: I don't mean to be difficult, but I've now been asked for the same document three times; is it possible it's been lost somewhere in the system?
alt: Not to be a nuisance, but this is the third time I've been asked for this document, so could it have gone missing in your system?
point: 让我交 → I've been asked for；弄丢 → it's been lost，委婉质疑

zh: 医生说「应该没什么事」，我反而更紧张了，因为这句话后面通常跟着「不过还是查一下吧」。
en: The doctor said it's 'probably nothing', which somehow didn't reassure me, because that's usually followed by 'but let's get it checked'.
alt: 'Probably nothing,' the doctor said, which didn't help, since the next line is usually 'but we'll run some tests'.
point: 后面跟着 → is followed by；去查 → get it checked

zh: 这场感冒把我折腾了两个星期，本以为硬扛一下就过去了，结果越拖越严重。
en: This cold's had me laid up for two weeks; I thought I could soldier on through it, but it's only got worse.
alt: I've been flattened by this cold for a fortnight; I tried to push through, but it's just got worse.
point: 把我折腾得卧床 → had me laid up，have + 宾语 + 过去分词

zh: 她说体检结果不用担心，可我总觉得有些事没讲清楚，可能会再找个医生看看。
en: She said there's nothing to worry about, but I can't shake the feeling something's not been fully explained, so I might get a second opinion.
alt: She told me not to worry, but I still feel I wasn't given the full picture, so I may see another doctor.
point: 没讲清楚 → hasn't been fully explained；再看一个医生 → second opinion

zh: 地震时我们被困在电梯里四十分钟，好在大家都很冷静，最后消防员把我们救了出来。
en: We were stuck in a lift for forty minutes during the quake, but everyone kept their cool until we were finally freed by the fire brigade.
alt: The quake trapped us in a lift for forty minutes, but everyone stayed calm until the firefighters got us out.
point: 被困 → were stuck；被救出 → were freed by

zh: 暴风雨那天整条街都停电了，我们跟外界断了两天联系，说实话还挺像露营的。
en: When the storm hit, the whole street lost power and we were cut off for two days, which, to be honest, felt a bit like camping.
alt: The storm knocked out power for the whole street and left us cut off for two days; honestly, it was a bit like camping.
point: 与外界断联 → were cut off，轻松幽默的语气

zh: 包被抢了以后我才意识到，我把所有东西都放在一处，这次也算是花钱买了个教训。
en: When my bag was snatched, I realised I'd kept everything in one place, so I guess you could say a lesson's been learnt.
alt: Having my bag grabbed made me realise I'd put all my eggs in one basket, so that's a lesson learnt the hard way.
point: 被抢 → was snatched；买了教训 → a lesson's been learnt

zh: 他发誓车「刚做过保养」，可我试驾时就觉得不对劲，隐约怀疑里程表被调过。
en: He swore the car had just been serviced, but something felt off on the test drive, and I've got a sneaking suspicion the odometer's been wound back.
alt: He insisted it had just had a service, but the test drive felt wrong, and I suspect the odometer's been tampered with.
point: 里程表被调 → has been wound back；隐约怀疑 → sneaking suspicion

zh: 我在高速上被一辆车别了一下，差点撞上，对方居然还冲我按喇叭，好像是我的错。
en: I got cut off by a car on the motorway and nearly hit it, and then the driver had the nerve to toot at me as if it was my fault.
alt: Someone cut in front of me on the motorway and nearly caused a crash, then had the cheek to toot as if I was to blame.
point: 被别车 → got cut off；居然还 → had the nerve to

zh: 我因为开进公交车道被罚了，可那条道的标线都磨得快看不见了，我觉得值得申诉一下。
en: I've been fined for driving in a bus lane, but the markings have been worn away so badly that I reckon it's worth a challenge.
alt: I got a bus lane fine, but the road markings are so faded you can barely see them, so I think I'll contest it.
point: 被罚 → have been fined；标线被磨掉 → have been worn away

zh: 航班超售，我们被挤下了飞机，不过赔偿给得挺大方，所以说实话我也没怎么生气。
en: The flight was overbooked and we got bumped, but the compensation was generous enough that I wasn't too put out, to be honest.
alt: They'd oversold the flight and bumped us, but they compensated us well, so honestly I wasn't that bothered.
point: 被挤下飞机 → got bumped；不太介意 → wasn't too put out

zh: 酒店的照片肯定是精修过的，实际房间小得连行李箱都打不开。
en: The hotel photos must have been heavily edited, because the room was so small we couldn't even open our suitcases.
alt: Those hotel photos were definitely doctored; the room was too tiny to even open a suitcase.
point: 肯定被修过 → must have been edited，推测过去的被动

zh: 我们本来只打算在那儿待两天，结果被那个地方迷住了，又多待了一个星期。
en: We'd only planned two days there, but we were so taken with the place that we ended up staying another week.
alt: We meant to stay just two days, but we fell in love with the place and stayed an extra week.
point: 被迷住 → were taken with，take 的被动习语

zh: 预报说「局部阵雨」，结果我们在山顶被淋成了落汤鸡，以后天气预报我只信一半。
en: The forecast said 'scattered showers', but we got absolutely drenched at the summit, so I'll be taking it with a grain of salt from now on.
alt: So much for 'scattered showers': we got soaked to the skin at the top, so I won't trust the forecast so readily again.
point: 被淋透 → got drenched；只信一半 → take it with a grain of salt

zh: 这条步道号称「适合全家」，我怀疑写这话的人从来没背过一个闹脾气的五岁孩子上山。
en: The track's billed as family-friendly, but I doubt whoever wrote that has ever had to carry a grumpy five-year-old up it.
alt: They call it a family walk, but I bet the person who said that never had to piggyback a cranky five-year-old to the top.
point: 号称 → is billed as，宣传用语的被动

zh: 我们在海滩被沙蝇咬得满身包，事后想想，驱虫水应该第一个装进包里的。
en: We got eaten alive by sandflies at the beach, and in hindsight, insect repellent should've been the first thing packed.
alt: The sandflies ate us alive at the beach; we really should have packed insect repellent first.
point: 被咬惨 → got eaten alive；该先装 → should've been packed

zh: 上半场我们完全被压着打，下半场才缓过来，最后能打平已经算捡到了。
en: We got completely outplayed in the first half and only came right after the break, so to be honest, a draw was more than we deserved.
alt: They ran rings around us in the first half, and we only got going after the break, so we were lucky to get a draw.
point: 被压着打 → got outplayed；缓过来 → came right（新西兰口语）

zh: 我稀里糊涂被朋友报了半程马拉松，现在已经后悔了，我连五公里都跑得够呛。
en: I've somehow been signed up for a half marathon by a mate, and I'm already regretting it, given I can barely manage five k.
alt: A mate's somehow got me entered in a half marathon, and I'm already regretting it, since I can hardly run five k.
point: 被报名 → have been signed up for by，人做被动主语

zh: 那个判罚真让我们吃了大亏，不过说句公道话，这个赛季裁判也照顾过我们几次。
en: We were robbed by that decision from the ref, but to be fair, we've been given the benefit of the doubt a few times this season too.
alt: That call from the ref cost us the game, though in fairness, a few calls have gone our way this season as well.
point: 被坑 → were robbed；被照顾 → been given the benefit of the doubt

zh: 这部剧被吹得那么神，我看了三集，说实话没看出好在哪儿。
en: That show's been talked up so much, but I'm three episodes in and honestly can't see what all the fuss is about.
alt: Everyone raves about that show, but three episodes in, I honestly don't get the hype.
point: 被吹捧 → has been talked up；好在哪 → what the fuss is about

zh: 一开始我对即兴表演没什么兴趣，结果第一节课就被拽上台，没想到一下子就迷上了。
en: I wasn't keen on improv at first, but I got hauled up on stage at my very first class, and I have to admit I was hooked.
alt: Improv didn't appeal to me at first, but they pulled me on stage in the first class, and I've been hooked ever since.
point: 被拽上台 → got hauled up；迷上 → was hooked

zh: 我第一次在Toastmasters演讲就因为超时被计时员打断了，当时真想找个地缝钻进去。
en: My first Toastmasters speech got cut short by the timer because I'd gone over, and honestly, I wanted the ground to swallow me up.
alt: I ran over time in my first Toastmasters speech and got stopped by the timer; I've never been so embarrassed.
point: 被打断 → got cut short by；找地缝 → wanted the ground to swallow me

zh: 他们又组织了周末出游，我好像又被「忘了」，可能是我想多了，但这已经是第三次了。
en: They've organised another weekend away and I seem to have been 'forgotten' again; maybe I'm reading too much into it, but it's the third time.
alt: Another weekend trip's been planned and I've apparently been 'forgotten' again; maybe I'm overthinking it, but that's three times now.
point: 好像被忘了 → seem to have been forgotten，引号表反讽

zh: 老有人问我「什么时候回国」，我知道没恶意，但总让我觉得自己永远会被当成外人。
en: I keep being asked when I'm 'going home', and I know it's not meant badly, but it does make me feel I'll always be seen as an outsider.
alt: People keep asking when I'm heading 'home', and I know they mean no harm, but it makes me feel like I'll never quite belong.
point: 没恶意 → it's not meant badly；被当成 → be seen as

zh: 有人叫我「带个盘子来」，我当时真以为是带个空盘子去，这事到现在还被他们拿来笑我。
en: When I was told to 'bring a plate', I genuinely thought I was meant to turn up with an empty one, and I've never been allowed to live it down.
alt: The first time someone said 'bring a plate', I showed up with an empty plate, and my friends still haven't let me forget it.
point: 被笑到现在 → never been allowed to live it down；bring a plate 指带菜

zh: 婚礼上我被安排坐在新娘的前男友旁边，那顿饭吃得说轻了也是有点尴尬。
en: At the wedding I was seated next to the bride's ex, which made for a slightly awkward dinner, to put it mildly.
alt: They put me next to the bride's ex at the reception, which was awkward, to say the least.
point: 被安排坐 → was seated next to；说轻了 → to put it mildly

zh: 今年圣诞轮到我们家办，婆婆已经「温柔地提醒」我好几次火鸡应该怎么烤了。
en: We're hosting Christmas this year, and I've been 'gently reminded' several times by my mother-in-law how the turkey's supposed to be done.
alt: Since we're doing Christmas this year, my mother-in-law has 'kindly suggested' more than once how I ought to cook the turkey.
point: 被提醒 → have been reminded；该怎么做 → is supposed to be done

zh: 我送她的礼物被她转送给了别人，我本来不介意，直到在别人家壁炉上看见它。
en: I didn't mind that my present had been regifted until I spotted it on someone else's mantelpiece; at least it went to a good home.
alt: I was fine with her passing my gift on until I saw it on another friend's mantelpiece, but hey, at least someone likes it.
point: 被转送 → had been regifted，过去完成被动 + 自嘲

zh: 女儿半夜偷偷溜出去被我们罚了一周不许出门，不过私下说，我像她这么大的时候也不是什么乖孩子。
en: Our daughter's been grounded for a week for sneaking out at night, though between you and me, I wasn't exactly an angel at her age either.
alt: We've grounded our daughter for a week for sneaking out, but just between us, I was no saint at her age.
point: 被禁足 → has been grounded；私下说 → between you and me

zh: 每次回国都被亲戚追着问什么时候要二胎，我现在已经学会笑一笑转移话题了。
en: Every time we go back to China, I get grilled by the relatives about having a second kid, so I've learnt to just smile and change the subject.
alt: Whenever we visit China, the relatives quiz me about a second baby, so now I just smile and steer the conversation elsewhere.
point: 被追问 → get grilled by，grill 表示连番盘问

zh: 公婆太宠孩子了，我们定的规矩每次他们一来就被悄悄打破，可我又不好说什么。
en: My in-laws spoil the kids rotten, and every rule we set gets quietly undone when they visit, but it's not really my place to say anything.
alt: My in-laws totally spoil the kids and our rules go out the window when they're around, but I don't feel I can say much.
point: 规矩被打破 → gets undone；不好说 → not my place to say

zh: 说好了狗是孩子们负责的，可你猜每天早上不管刮风下雨被拉出去遛狗的是谁？
en: The dog was meant to be the kids' responsibility, but guess who gets dragged out for walks every morning, rain or shine?
alt: Supposedly the kids would look after the dog, but guess who ends up walking him every morning, whatever the weather?
point: 说好了 → was meant to be；被拉出去 → gets dragged out

zh: 我怀疑邻居也在喂我们的猫，她最近胖了一大圈，看来她在外面还有个家。
en: I think our cat's being fed by the neighbours as well, because she's put on a fair bit of weight; she's clearly got two homes on the go.
alt: I reckon the neighbours are feeding our cat too, since she's got quite chubby; she's obviously running two households.
point: 被邻居喂 → is being fed by，进行时被动 + 幽默

zh: 我一直跟快递员说狗不咬人，可他好像不太信，说句公道话，他大概是被那阵狂叫吓怕了。
en: I keep telling the courier the dog's harmless, but I don't think he's convinced; to be fair, he's probably been put off by all the barking.
alt: I've told the courier the dog won't bite, but he's not buying it, and fair enough, the barking would scare anyone.
point: 不信 → isn't convinced；被吓退 → has been put off by

zh: 我知道你是好意，但那话听着有点像在挖苦我，可能是我太敏感，不过我确实有点不舒服。
en: I know you meant well, but what you said came across as a bit of a dig, and it may just be me, but I was a bit put out.
alt: I'm sure you didn't mean it, but it felt like a dig, and maybe I'm being oversensitive, but it did sting a bit.
point: 有点不爽 → was a bit put out，put out 被动表不快

zh: 我不是非要别人感谢，只是希望我做的事能被看见，哪怕偶尔有人提一句也好。
en: It's not that I need to be thanked; I'd just like to feel that what I do is noticed, even if it's only occasionally acknowledged.
alt: I'm not after thanks; I just want to know my work gets noticed, even if it's only mentioned now and then.
point: 被感谢 → need to be thanked；被看见 → is noticed

zh: 分手以后我整个人都空了，朋友们一直想拉我出去，可说实话我现在只想一个人待着。
en: Since the break-up I've felt completely gutted, and my friends keep trying to drag me out, but honestly I'd rather be left alone for a while.
alt: I've been gutted since we split, and my mates keep trying to get me out, but to be honest I just want some time on my own.
point: 想一个人待着 → rather be left alone；心碎 → gutted
